reviews.title: Great value for an ATX motherboard
reviews.comment: I replaced my dying motherboard with this model and it runs flawlessly with a 7800X3D and 2X32GB CL30 memory. It came with BIOS version 3.30 installed. The top M.2 slot has a neat sliding mechanism which can lock your drive in place without having to screw anything in. The addressable RGB is quite nice too (which can be turned off if it's not your thing). I did have a slight issue with the WiFi not activating on first boot. This was a little annoying, since changing your motherboard makes your old Windows pins useless and requires you to login to your Microsoft account to reset them and finally login to your PC. To get around this, I had to first connect via ethernet, fix my login, then download and install the drivers from the motherboard support website. After that it worked. So don't be dumb like me. I recommend disabling Bitlocker first, not using a Windows pin number and download the drivers BEFORE changing your motherboard.
reviews.author: Reuben

reviews.title: Secretly faster than most boards..
reviews.comment: Extremely fast operating frequency for CCD1 and CCD2 coming in at 5100Mhz. It's faster than the Gigabyte Aorus Elite (5040Mhz) and the Asus ROG Strix (5010Mhz). For the price you just can't beat it, it dominates boards that cost double the price. It doesn't have drivers for Windows 10 and you'll experience intermittent ethernet connection issues. The drivers work perfectly on Windows 11 though. Currently running my 9800X3D at 5.22Ghz with 6000mhz ram.
reviews.author: Daniel Kase

reviews.title: It works!

reviews.author: Orlando

reviews.title: Good solid board that looks great!
reviews.comment: A few reasons for 4 star I'll get into later, but a 5 star board overall. Excellent motherboard and with what I'm using with it I am very happy with my purchase. The board looks great, the bios out of the box supported my Ryzen 9000 series CPU, and it supports my GSkill 6400 M/T CAS 30 memory. Great RGB control! I have full control of the RGB on my memory and the 6 fans (+2 on my 240 radiator) so I can pretty much make my glass case any color I want. Reason for the 4 stars: If you're not on Windows 11 yet, you'll have to be. I was running Windows 10 Pro completely content, and holding out until much later to make the free jump to Windows 11. Did a fresh Windows 10 Pro load after installing this motherboard, only to find that there aren't any Wifi 7 drivers for Windows 10. So to get onboard Wifi working I was forced to upgrade to Windows 11. Has plenty of M.2 slots, and this isn't an issue because I have 1 gen 5 and 1 gen 4, but this board has 1 gen 5, 1 gen 4, and 1 gen 3 M.2 slots. Not a huge deal, I just found it interesting when I did my sons build with a B850 Pro RS it came with 1 gen 5, 2 gen 4, and 1 gen 3. Again, not a dealbreaker, but I thought that was strange. Upgraded to a Ryzen 9 9900X and the EXPO stopped working in the Bios. Couldn't get my memory up to 6400 M/T. Not a big deal as I was able to bypass it and set the EXPO in Ryzenmaster.
